features.name: Personalized home waterfall orchestration
steps: The user opens the home page
The system shows a mix of image-text, video, and other note cards
Each content type's structure is presented correctly
features.expected: The home page must present image-text/video note cards in a waterfall layout; the two card structures are distinguishable; scrolling loads without duplication or loss; blank cards or layout collapse must not occur.

features.name: Home channel category switching
steps: Switch between channels such as recommended, outfits, food, makeup, film & TV, workplace, relationships, home, games, travel, and fitness
The content set changes with the channel
Returning to recommended restores the original context
features.expected: After switching channels the content set must change with the channel; each channel's results are distinguishable; after returning to recommended the original context is restored (content and scroll position); the filtering process must not lose already-loaded content.

features.name: Continuous waterfall browsing and position restoration
steps: The original waterfall content and scroll position are restored
features.expected: Scrolling down must keep loading notes; after opening content and returning the original waterfall content and scroll position must be restored; loaded notes are neither duplicated nor lost; a full-page reload must not be triggered.

features.name: Short-video continuous consumption stream
features.expected: When switching to the next item the previous one must stop and the next one plays from the beginning; after switching several items in succession the playback state is always correct; double audio or a black screen must not occur.

features.name: Live discovery and category browsing
steps: Filter by categories such as all, games, talent & looks, and life sharing
features.expected: The live list must be displayed according to the preset data; each category filter gives correct results; the list updates in sync after switching categories; a category with no data shows an empty state.

features.name: Global content search and query state
steps: Search related notes, users, or content
The original keyword, filter conditions, and result position are preserved
features.expected: The search results must match the keyword and cover types such as notes/users; after opening a result and returning the original keyword, filter conditions, and result position must be preserved.

features.name: User-behavior-driven note interaction state
steps: Enter the corresponding "likes" or "favorites" area on the profile
The same note can be found
It disappears in sync after cancelling
features.expected: The state changes immediately after liking/favoriting; the same note appears in the corresponding profile area; after cancelling it disappears from both places in sync; the state must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Personal aggregation of liked content
steps: The user likes several image-text/video notes
Aggregate and display all liked content
Reopening still keeps the liked state
The list changes in sync after unliking
features.expected: "Me—likes" must aggregate all liked content; reopening keeps the liked state; after unliking the item is removed from the list in sync; the count matches the list.

features.name: Multi-type aggregation of favorited content
steps: Favorite image-text, video, album, or file-type content
The favorite count and list update in sync
features.expected: "Me—favorites" must display correctly by content category; after unfavoriting the count and list update in sync; different content types must not be mixed up.

features.name: Follow relationships and list-state sync
steps: That user's content enters the consumable range
features.expected: After following, the following count changes; "people I follow" correctly shows them; that user's content enters the consumable range; after unfollowing it syncs back.

features.name: Profile content aggregation
steps: Show the avatar, bio, region, following count, follower count, likes received, and favorites
The content and counts stay consistent
features.expected: The avatar / bio / region / following count / follower count / likes and favorites must be displayed correctly; the notes / favorites / likes tabs' content and counts are consistent; swi

features.name: Private-note visibility setting
steps: Set the note to self-visible-only when publishing
After changing the public state the setting updates in sync
The home-page status indicator is correct
features.expected: After setting self-visible-only it saves successfully and the state is correctly reflected; after changing the public state the setting updates in sync; the home-page state marker matches the setting; the configuration must persist.

features.name: Multi-form creation entry orchestration
steps: Enter different creation paths such as image-text notes and video notes
Each content type enters an independent creation flow
features.expected: The image-text/video creation entries must enter the corresponding workflow; different workflows are distinguishable; the home-page state is preserved after returning; entries must not cross positions.

features.name: Image-note creation and publishing
steps: Edit the title, body, topic, and other information
It finally appears on the profile
features.expected: The edited content and publishing properties are saved correctly; after submitting the state follows the preset flow; after publishing the note appears on the profile; a clear state is given on failure.

features.name: Video-note upload and publishing
steps: Configure the cover and content information
The video enters the note system
features.expected: The upload must show progress; the cover and content-information configuration is saved correctly; after publishing the video enters the note system; a clear state is given when the upload fails.

features.name: Note draft and publish-state management
steps: After submitting it enters under-review (preset flow)
On approval it becomes published / on failure it enters the rejected state
features.expected: After saving, the draft exists in the draft box; after continuing to edit the content is correctly restored; after submitting it follows the preset state flow (under review → published / rejected); each state marker is correct.

features.name: Note management and state filtering
steps: Filter by all, published, under review, and rejected
After an operation the corresponding state list changes in sync
features.expected: Each state filter (all / published / under review / rejected) gives correct results; searching hits the specified note; after an operation the corresponding state list changes in sync.

features.name: Content moderation state and state linkage
steps: The console shows the corresponding state
The front end displays by state
After approval it enters the normal display / failure prompt state
features.expected: After submitting it is displayed with the preset moderation state; the console and front-end states are consistent; on approval it enters normal display and on failure it shows a prompt state; the state must persist.

features.name: Notification categories and interaction-event aggregation
steps: Preset notifications (comments, mentions, likes, favorites, follows)
Display by category in "comments and mentions / likes and favorites / new follows"
The unread state changes after reading
features.expected: The preset notifications must make the entry show unread; each category (comments and mentions / likes and favorites / new follows) is correctly classified; the unread state updates in sync after reading.

features.name: The navigation loop from notifications to business objects
steps: Jump to the corresponding note, comment, or user
The notification state stays read after returning
features.expected: Tapping a preset notification must jump to the corresponding note/comment/user; the notification state stays read after returning; the unread count decreases in sync.

features.name: Private-message sessions and group-chat management
features.expected: Single and group chat lists are displayed correctly (preset); selecting a session loads the corresponding history; new messages show unread correctly; after reading the corresponding unread is cleared.

features.name: Creator home data overview
steps: The creator enters the console home
Summarize metrics such as exposure, views, likes, comments, net follower growth, new follows, unfollows, and profile visitors
Switch the date to view different statistical periods
features.expected: Each metric (exposure/views/likes, etc.) must be displayed correctly; after switching the date the statistical period changes in sync; the data matches the preset snapshot.

features.name: Single-note content performance analysis
steps: View exposure, views, cover click-through rate, likes, comments, favorites, follower growth, shares, average watch time, etc.
features.expected: The notes are listed correctly by the filter conditions; each metric is displayed correctly; the sort and export results match the current filter; the export content is complete.

features.name: Follower-growth trend analysis
steps: View total followers, new followers, and lost followers
Switch between the last seven days / last thirty days
The trend chart changes in sync
features.expected: Total followers / new / lost are displayed correctly; after switching between the last seven/thirty days the trend chart changes in sync; the data matches the preset snapshot.

features.name: Follower profile display
steps: Show the aggregated profile (preset data, by activity/interest dimensions)
An empty state is shown when the data is insufficient
The aggregated profile is displayed when the data condition is met
features.expected: When the data is insufficient an empty state must be shown; once the condition is met the aggregated profile is displayed (preset data); the profile dimensions match the preset; switching the condition gives correct results.

features.name: Account data summary and peer comparison
steps: The console summarizes views, follower growth, profile visitors, post count, and interactions
features.expected: All summary metrics are displayed correctly; the peer-comparison benchmark is correctly applied; the data matches the preset snapshot; the comparison results are distinguishable.

features.name: Creation inspiration and hot-topic browsing
steps: Browse the topic list by category (preset popularity data)
View the participant count, view count, and representative content
Choose a topic and enter creation
features.expected: The topic list must be displayed correctly by category (preset popularity data); the participant/view counts are consistent; after selecting a topic it enters the corresponding creation flow.

features.name: Creator activity participation and favorites
steps: The state changes after the activity expires
features.expected: The activity list and details are displayed correctly; after favoriting/unfavoriting "my favorites" updates in sync; after an activity expires its state changes correctly.

features.name: Site-wide behavior events and data consistency
steps: The user browses, likes, favorites, follows, comments on, and shares notes
The front-end interaction count and state change
The related areas on the personal side (favorites/likes/following lists) stay consistent
features.expected: After browsing/liking/favoriting/following/commenting/sharing, the front-end interaction counts and the personal areas (favorites/likes/following lists) must stay consistent; single-point omissions must not occur.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
Interest- and behavior-driven waterfall ranking and content recommendation
exclusions.reason: Requires a recommendation model and behavior data (cf. Spotify "Recommendation / personalization engine"); the waterfall structure can use preset fixtures

exclusions.feature:
Live
Live creation, streaming, real-time live-room interaction, and the live lifecycle
exclusions.reason: Live-streaming dependencies (cf. YouTube "live" exclusion); live-list browsing (category filtering) can be kept; retained surface: f05 live discovery and category browsing

exclusions.feature:
Content moderation system
Real moderation queues, decision results, and moderation duration
exclusions.reason: The moderation state machine and state linkage are testable; the moderation results are driven by preset fixtures; retained surface: f17 note management and state filtering, f18 content moderation state and state linkage

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of others' interactions
Real generation of comments/mentions/likes/favorites/follows
exclusions.reason: The notification category/navigation/read state machine is testable and requires preset notification fixtures; retained surface: f19 notification categories and interaction-event aggregation

exclusions.feature:
Real peers in private messages
Real user message send/receive and real-time push
exclusions.reason: The session list/unread/history loading is testable (preset sessions); real peers are not verified; retained surface: f21 private-message sessions and group-chat management

exclusions.feature:
Two-way propagation of follow relationships
The other party's follower count changes and their side's statistics update
exclusions.reason: The local follow state is testable; the other side's data is presented via fixtures; retained surface: f10 follow relationships and list-state sync

exclusions.feature:
External visibility verification
Other users accessing private notes and verifying public content streams
exclusions.reason: The visibility-setting save and state reflection are testable; external access effects are not verified; retained surface: f12 private-note visibility setting, f17 note management and state filtering, f18 content moderation state and state linkage

exclusions.feature:
Follower-profile computation
Profile algorithms and real user-data aggregation
exclusions.reason: Profile display and the empty state are testable; the profile data uses preset fixtures; retained surface: f25 follower profile display

exclusions.feature:
Account diagnosis and improvement suggestions
Algorithmic diagnosis results and generative suggestions
exclusions.reason: Generative/algorithmic output is non-deterministic; the metric summary and comparison display (preset benchmarks) can be kept; retained surface: f26 account data summary and peer comparison

exclusions.feature:
The real statistics engine behind the creator console
Real-time computation of exposure/views/follower growth, etc.
exclusions.reason: Metric display, period switching, and sort/export are testable; the data uses preset fixtures; retained surface: f22 creator home data overview, f23 single-note content performance analysis, f26 account data summary and peer comparison

exclusions.feature:
Real-time hot-topic data
Real participant counts, view counts, and popularity rankings
exclusions.reason: Topic browsing and entering creation are testable; the popularity data uses static snapshots (cf. Spotify "Dynamic charts"); retained surface: f03 continuous waterfall browsing and position restoration, f27 creation inspiration and hot-topic browsing

exclusions.feature:
Video transcoding and platform processing
Media-processing pipelines and transcoding states
exclusions.reason: The upload and publish flow is testable; a real processing pipeline is not required (cf. YouTube "transcoding/CDN"); retained surface: f14 image-note creation and publishing, f15 video-note upload and publishing, f16 note draft and publish-state management

exclusions.feature:
Real content assets
Real note content, user data, and campaign operations content
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic fixture content (cf. Spotify "Real catalog"); activity favorite interactions can be kept; retained surface: f28 creator activity participation and favorites
